QuestInfo.name: Third Material Delivery for Building a New House
QuestInfo.parent: Ronnie & the Fairies Building a New House
QuestInfo.1: #p320# asked me to hunt #r50 #o30#s#k and #r50 #o40#s#k and collect #b30 #t4000026##k and #b30 #t4000036##k. I should be able to get them from the monsters around #m10004000#. Things are starting to get a bit tricky...
QuestInfo.2: I got everything for #p320#. I still didn't get anything?? How many more times do I have to do this??

0.0: Huh... You're already ready? You really are impatient... Don't rush so much! All right, then. This time, can you take down #r50 #o30#s and 50 #o40#s#k and bring me #b30 #t4000026# and #t4000036#s#k? I'm counting on you!

yes.0: Thanks! I think you should travel around the #m10004000# area this time. When you get all those items, please bring them to me. I'll be waiting here!

no.0: Yeah... You can't take a request from a kid... yeah... right... If you change your mind, please let me know... I can't do this on my own...

1.0: Wow, you collected it all! Great! This one was harder than last time, right? What? It was nothing? Haha... Anyway, I'll give these to the fairies, but we're not done yet...

yes.0: I got the materials... Yeah... It was a good idea to ask you for a favor... Thanks... but there are still more things to get. Whenever you're ready, please talk to me again!

mob.0: Don't forget to take down the monsters too!

item.0: It looks like you still haven't gathered everything I asked for yet. But keep it up! It may be tough, but if you help me out a few more times, I'll give you something really nice!
